User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the system.

roles.description: The user's roles (e.g., ucitel, rodic, ziak, administrator, vedouci pracovnik, asistent pedagoga).

tridaId.description: Reference to Trida. (Relationship: User N:1 Trida) The class ID to which the user belongs.

studentId.description: For parents, the ID of their child student.

pin.description: A 6-digit PIN for initial user registration.

Trida.title: Trida
Trida.description: Represents a class (trida) in the school.

ucitelId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N Trida) The ID of the teacher in charge of the class.

zastupciIds.description: References to Users. An array of substitute class teacher IDs.

asistentiIds.description: References to Users. An array of pedagogical assistant IDs.

ziaciIds.description: References to Users. (Relationship: User N:N Trida) An array of student IDs belonging to this class.

Znamka.title: Znamka
Znamka.description: Represents a grade (znamka) for a student.

studentId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N Znamka) The ID of the student who received the grade.

predmet.description: The subject for which the grade was given.

datum.description: The date the grade was given.

ucitelId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N Znamka) The ID of the teacher who gave the grade.

slovniHodnoceni.description: Verbal assessment or comment for the grade.

tema.description: The topic or subject matter of the assessment.

druhHodnoceni.description: The type of assessment (e.g., written, oral).

Rozvrh.title: Rozvrh
Rozvrh.description: Represents a class schedule (rozvrh) for a specific day and class.

tridaId.description: Reference to Trida. (Relationship: Trida 1:N Rozvrh) The ID of the class for which the schedule is defined.

Oznameni.title: Oznameni
Oznameni.description: Represents an announcement (oznameni) for a class.

proTridu.description: Reference to Trida. (Relationship: Trida 1:N Oznameni) The ID of the class for which the announcement is intended.

datum.description: The date the announcement was created.

Predmet.title: Predmet
Predmet.description: Represents a subject taught in school.

shortcut.description: A short abbreviation for the subject.

teacherCount.description: The number of teachers teaching this subject.

Ucebna.title: Ucebna
Ucebna.description: Represents a classroom in the school.

nazev.description: The name or number of the classroom.

PoznamkaZaka.title: PoznamkaZaka
PoznamkaZaka.description: Represents a note for a student.

predmet.description: The subject related to the note.

druh.description: Type of note (e.g., pochvala, zapomenuté pomůcky).

ucitelId.description: Reference to the teacher who wrote the note.

datumPodpisu.description: Date the note was signed by a parent.

Udalost.title: Udalost
Udalost.description: Represents a general event in the school calendar.

typ.description: The type of event (e.g., Školní akce, Porada).

tridyIds.description: List of class IDs involved in the event.

uciteleIds.description: List of teacher IDs involved in the event.

nahrazujeHodiny.description: If true, this event replaces regular lessons at the same time.

Substitution.title: Substitution
Substitution.description: Represents a temporary change (substitution) for a specific lesson on a specific date.

LessonBlock.title: LessonBlock
LessonBlock.description: A reusable block representing a single lesson in a schedule.

ScheduleTemplate.title: ScheduleTemplate
ScheduleTemplate.description: A template for a class's weekly schedule.

days.description: An array of day objects representing the week's schedule.

StorableDay.title: StorableDay
StorableDay.description: Represents a single day's schedule to be stored in Firestore.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single message between users.

readBy.description: List of user IDs who have read the message.

ZapisHodiny.title: ZapisHodiny
ZapisHodiny.description: Represents an entry in the class book for a specific lesson.

topic.description: The topic covered in the lesson.

Omluvenka.title: Omluvenka
Omluvenka.description: Represents an excuse for a student's absence submitted by a parent.

ZapisDoPrvniTridy.title: ZapisDoPrvniTridy
ZapisDoPrvniTridy.description: Represents an application for first-grade enrollment.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to provide a secure and scalable data model for the ŠkolaWeb application. It addresses the requirements for user management, class management, grade management, scheduling, and announcements. The structure is optimized for role-based access control (učitel, rodic, ziak, administrator) and aims to minimize the need for complex security rules. The key strategy for achieving authorization independence is denormalization. For example, the `tridaId` is included in the `users` collection to avoid `get()` calls in security rules to verify the `trida` of a given `user`. This approach enables atomic operations and simplifies security rule debugging.

To support the QAPs, the structure leverages structural segregation. User-specific data (grades) are stored in subcollections of the `users` collection, ensuring that only the authenticated user (or a teacher/parent) can access their own (or their child's) data. Announcements are segregated by class, enabling efficient listing of announcements relevant to a specific class. Collaborative data (such as class schedules) resides under the `tridy` collection, using the document ID as the `tridaId`.

Membership maps aren't explicitly used here, but the structure allows for easy extension with membership maps if collaborative features become more complex in the future. For instance, if a more granular role system within a class is needed (e.g., assigning students to groups), a `members` map could be added to the `tridy/{tridaId}` document.
